text.offer: Paddock says, "Castle Victoria was the old seat of the kingdom. Far'Nohl, the King in that era, is said to have gone mad after delving too deeply into dark magics, and folk say the dead walk its halls now. Drechx of the old council keeps a camp outside its gates, watching the place. Go and find him: he knows more about that castle than anyone living."
text.complete: Drechx says, "Paddock sent you? Then you're braver than most. Stay a while. That castle needs cleansing, room by room, and I'm too old to do it myself."

steps.brief: Castle Victoria lies directly south from Tos, through the Cragged Mountains. You will have to cross Ukgoth, the Holy Land of Trolls, and find the castle in the north-west corner of that land. Run past any trolls or black spiders you are too weak to fight.

steps.objective: Talk to Drechx outside the castle
steps.brief: Drechx of the old council keeps watch outside the gates of Castle Victoria. Find him and talk to him.
